cord.label: Cord Touring
cord.description: Natural-rubber and cotton-cord inspiration; simple rib tread, modest grip and a low-speed profile.

belted.label: Belted Touring
belted.description: Synthetic-rubber and belted-bias inspiration; repeating zigzag blocks, improved road holding.

touring.label: Steel Radial
touring.description: Steel-belted radial inspiration; conventional block tread and balanced touring behavior.

economy.label: Eco Touring
economy.description: Modern silica-compound inspiration; fine drainage/siping and low rolling resistance.

sport.label: Sport Radial
sport.description: Modern performance-compound inspiration; directional tread and stronger dry grip.

road.label: Performance Road
road.description: Existing high-speed road fit; broad drainage channels.

track.label: Track Semi-Slick
track.description: Broad contact patches with sparse grooves for dry track use.

drag.label: Drag
drag.description: Straight-line traction at the expense of lateral grip.
